subject.title: fix(openrouter): use dedicated /api/v1/images endpoint for image generation

question: Should OpenClaw accept `endpointPath` as the public Plugin SDK seam for flat OpenAI-compatible image endpoints in this PR?
rationale: The option is additive and tested, but it is exported through `openclaw/plugin-sdk/image-generation`, so this becomes a third-party plugin contract rather than an OpenRouter-only implementation detail.

options.title: Accept endpointPath
options.body: Keep the shared factory design, update the remaining image-generation docs, and treat `endpointPath` as the supported flat-endpoint SDK seam.

options.title: Keep endpoint local
options.body: Remove the public option and implement OpenRouter's flat `/images` URL handling inside the OpenRouter provider if maintainers do not want to expand the SDK yet.

options.title: Pause for SDK review
options.body: Hold the PR until a plugin SDK owner decides the permanent helper contract for flat image endpoints.

recommendation.title: Accept endpointPath
recommendation.body: Keep the shared factory design, update the remaining image-generation docs, and treat `endpointPath` as the supported flat-endpoint SDK seam.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on shared image helpers and the public Plugin SDK export path where steipete has the strongest history signal.
